verdicts.reason: Kind: fact. S10 shows MAS Notice 643A (Amendment) 2026, issued 4 September 2026 and taking effect 4 September 2027.
Kind: fact. S6 lists MAS consultation number P015-2026 on amending the Payment Services Act 2019 for stablecoins, starting 1 September 2026. S8 confirms MAS published it.

Kind: fact. S9 says a Minister moved the Financial Services and Markets (Amendment) Bill 2026 for First Reading in Parliament, on behalf of the Minister in charge of MAS. The bill would give MAS the power to set TLAC requirements. MAS consulted on it and published the explanatory brief, but the source does not say MAS issued the bill, so the claim names the wrong actor.
Kind: fact. S6 gives the closing date as 16 October 2026. S8, S3, S5 and S7 confirm 16 October.

Kind: fact. S2, the MAS Managing Director's speech, says MAS 'has also issued a set of Guidelines for AI Risk Management for public consultation'. Guidelines out for consultation are draft guidelines.

Kind: fact. S13 (published 23 Sep 2026, before the run date) says Singapore published its national AML strategy, produced jointly by MHA, MOF and MAS. MAS is named as a co-author, so saying MAS issued it is supported, though it was a joint publication.
